title: Surreal Corn Goddess Warrior
description: A colossal female figure with a green military helmet covered in skulls merges with a corn cob face, one eye replaced by the text 'JAZ'. Her body is a mix of flesh, skeleton, and vegetation. She stands on a grassy cliff overlooking a fantastical landscape with a river, tanks, soldiers, a domed temple, and a futuristic city under a dramatic swirling sunset sky filled with stars and hearts.
prompt: A massive hybrid female warrior with a military helmet adorned with skulls, her face formed from a corn cob with one eye replaced by the word JAZ in colorful letters, wearing a tattered green veil. Her body transitions from flesh to skeleton with visible ribs and corn leaves. She stands on a floating grassy cliff. Below is a winding river with military tanks and boats, tiny soldiers carrying a flag that says CORN, a blue domed temple, and a futuristic city in the distance. Dramatic swirling purple, pink and orange sunset sky filled with stars and hearts.
